column4: a growth atom is not one file: the module's existing oracle (M3EvictingQueueCanonicalContractProbe) asserted the old 1.5x expansion floor (> 700,000; master emits 739,429) and the canonical-owner workflow pins the postimage sha256 and normalizes admitted lines; both had to move with the atom (third EDIT rule = exact count 453,002 from the donor README; workflow pin + one normalization pair). Grep .github/workflows and src/test for the owner's sha256 and private method names before declaring an atom single-file

column4: differential oracles compile the pre-change class from a hash-pinned fixture (src/test/resources/.../*.preimage.java.txt) into a separate package and URLClassLoader at test time, so the master bytes are proved without a second module or a jar; the package line is the only rewrite

a 'probes once' claim on a final class with a private find() cannot be counted through a subclass hook; count it on the javap -c listing of the method (find:(I)I once, no containsKey/getOrDefault, remove:(I)Z twice)

writing Python that emits a backslash escape (b'...\n') through the Bash tool collapses the doubled backslash into a real newline; such edits go through the Edit tool and are re-checked by running the extracted workflow script locally
